changes: First version, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: SY RAVE, a six-voice digital chord stab on the BD, SD and BT tracks.
Thirteen chords (CHD) and nine voicings (VOI), taken at each hit so locked steps play a progression; the note transposes the chord; the knobs show their names.
DET spreads the voices, WAV runs saw to square to narrow pulse, PCH zaps the chord down or scoops it up and STR strums it upwards at the hit; tap the TUN encoder for the register.
